title: 16 Days to EO Deadline: Highest UAP Disclosure Activity Concentration Since July 2023
detail: As of May 4, 2026, with 16 days remaining until Trump's executive order 90-day deadline (May 20), the UAP disclosure landscape shows the highest concentration of official and institutional activity since the July 26, 2023 House Oversight hearing. Active fronts: (1) Rep. Luna coordinating with Chairman Comer on a formal subpoena for 46 classified Pentagon UAP videos; (2) Trump's May 3 comments to reporters that pilots told him they 'saw things you wouldn't believe,' confirming he has personally interviewed military witnesses; (3) The Greer National Press Club disclosure event on May 8, featuring Army Green Beret testimony about non-human artifact storage facilities; (4) The FBI's active involvement in investigating the death of potential whistleblower Matthew Sullivan. Coverage by The Columbian and Newsmax on May 4 noted Trump's continued hints about specific file contents ahead of the deadline.
confidenceReason: Synthesis of confirmed developments from multiple verified sources. Individual components (Luna subpoena, Trump statements, Sullivan investigation, Greer event) all confirmed by independent reporting.

media.caption: 16 days to EO deadline with multiple UAP disclosure fronts active simultaneously
